strategy: Sell local-currency forwards 3 months, hedging 50% of EM local-currency bond exposure; roll quarterly
applies_to: EM local-currency bond funds in the 35% bond sleeve (EMLC, LEMB, ELD, PELBX etc.); exposure = fund NAV x local-currency share
proxy_source: Yahoo spot FX (fx.csv) plus short rates (see overlays_notes.md availability table)
proxy_since: spots from 2005; rates vary by country
model: Covered interest parity: F = S x (1 + i_usd x 3/12) / (1 + i_loc x 3/12). Hedge P&L per roll = (F0 - S_T) / S0 x hedged notional. Country weights from latest fund factsheet held fixed (look-ahead flag)
parameters_to_test: hedge ratio 50%; tenor 3m; currencies hedged: all with a rate series, vs the liquid three only (MXN, BRL, ZAR); hedge gives up roughly (i_loc - i_usd) of carry
assumptions_needed: 3m rates from FRED/OECD IR3TIB01 or central-bank policy rates (see notes table); CIP does not hold well for NDF markets (BRL, INR, IDR, CLP, COP onshore vs offshore); fund country weights (factsheet, date) must be recorded by the EM bond screener; no free CIP basis data
cost_model: FX forwards 5 bps per roll on hedged notional (method.md s10), about 20 bps/yr at quarterly rolls, on top of forward points; no margin assumed
min_account_size_note: Bank forwards and NDFs are not normally available to a $100k brokerage account (not verified for a specific broker). Hedged notional is at most ~$17,500 x 50% = under $9,000, likely below one CME EM FX futures contract (sizes not verified). Practical route: a currency-hedged fund if one exists, or CME FX futures on MXN/BRL/ZAR only
non_us_share_rule: Same as the bond fund underlying: 1.0 (EM bonds); hedging does not change issuer domicile
notes: Hedge lowers carry but cuts the FX share of variance. A fully hedged local fund behaves like a rate-duration product without currency risk
